[Vesuvius at a glance](/en/about-us/overview.html) ## [POD heading](/en/investors/results-reports-presentations.html) ![ ](/content/vesuvius/corporate/en/index/_jcr_content/topnavmultimenu/topnavmultimenu/topnavmultimenuitem_about-us/par/pageteaser/image.img.jpg/1775646641032.jpg " ") ### subheading Annual Report for the year ended 31 December 2025. ## Our Solutions Vesuvius is a global leader in metal flow engineering, providing a full range of engineering services and solutions to its customers worldwide, principally serving the steel and foundry industries. [Explore our solutions](/en/our-solutions.html) ## [POD heading](/en/our-solutions/international/iron-and-steel/steel-making/melting/basic-oxygen-furnace.html) ![ ](/content/vesuvius/corporate/en/index/_jcr_content/topnavmultimenu/topnavmultimenu/topnavmultimenuitem_our-solutions/par/pageteaser/image.img.jpg/1680523246698.jpg " ") ### subheading Solutions for Basic Oxygen Furnace. ## Investors The main principle of Vesuvius' Investor Relations is to deliver timely, accurate and relevant information to Vesuvius' stakeholders. [Visit our investor information](/en/investors/shareholder-information.html) ## [POD heading](/en/investors/results-reports-presentations.html) ![ ](/content/vesuvius/corporate/en/index/_jcr_content/topnavmultimenu/topnavmultimenu/topnavmultimenuitem_investors/par/pageteaser/image.img.png/1773267933158.png " ") ### subheading Our Full Year Results for 2025, announced on 12 March 2026. ## Sustainability Vesuvius has identified the practices within its operations that can directly or indirectly contribute to the United Nations Sustainability Goals (SDGs). We will focus our efforts on the following six SDGs where we believe we can make the most meaningful contribution. [Find out more](/en/sustainability/ambition-and-strategy/unsdg.html) ## ![ ](/content/vesuvius/corporate/en/index/_jcr_content/topnavmultimenu/topnavmultimenu/topnavmultimenuitem_sustainability/par/pageteaser/image.img.png/1680523245367.png " ") ### We are committed to reducing the environmental footprint of both our own and our customers' operations. We have set an objective to reach a net zero carbon footprint, at the latest by 2050. ## Careers The dedication and professionalism of our people is the most significant contributor to Vesuvius’ success. snippet: # Robert Matuszewski - Head of Sales [**EN**](#) [PL](/pl/o-nas/met-poland-team/robert-matuszewski/) ![searchIcon](/assets/img/search.svg) [About us](/en/about-us/about-met-poland/) [Product offer](/en/product-offer/sales-of-electricity/) [Media](https://met.com/en/media/) [Career](/en/career/career-portal/) ## Robert Matuszewski ![MET Robert Matuszewski](/media/w13ngohc/rm_photo_s.png?width=1920&v=1dc5870c865d2d0&rmode=min&format=webp&quality=85) ## **Robert Matuszewski Head of Sales** I have been working in the energy sector for over 20 years, and for more than a decade I have specialized in the sale of electricity and gas, as well as in developing sales solutions tailored to the individual needs of clients. I work with both Polish and international companies, supporting them in optimizing energy costs and navigating the complexities of the energy market. I specialize in flexible procurement models that enable effective cost and risk management. I support companies in concluding energy purchase agreements, offering solutions aligned with their procurement strategies and sustainability goals. I assist with both Power Purchase Agreements and Guarantees of Origin, helping businesses verify their use of renewable energy sources and meet ESG policy objectives. For many years, I have also been developing partnerships with business partners, creating innovative solutions that support both the partners themselves and their clients in the energy sector. Currently, hold the position of Head of Sales at MET Polska, where I am responsible for sales to key accounts and the SME segment. I manage both internal and external sales channels, focusing on process optimization, digitalization, and product development, including PPAs. Previously, I gained experience working for major energy groups such as ČEZ Group, Ignitis Group, and PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna. I also served as a consultant at the international advisory firm E&C Consultants, advising clients on procurement strategies and energy risk management.
